purpose: Validate native perception-mesh materialization and exact geometry replay on ten preselected train-only recipe sentinels before any 100-parent mesh batch.

approval.scope: One M0 execution: ten fixed C01 train sentinels, primary plus exact replay native meshes, ten complete train previews, no validation/development-test inspection and no LiDAR, labels or training.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续吧那 after receiving the completed V2R summary and the exact M0 scope.

source.selection: accepted_rank_in_recipe=1 in each of ten recipes
source.mutation_policy: All source runs and manifests are read-only; M0 outputs go to a new immutable run.

geometry.backend: Pinned Cano TunnelNetworkMeshGenerator native Poisson perception mesh
geometry.geometry_seed_policy: Use the unique reserved_geometry_seed already frozen for each V2 parent.
geometry.fta_distance_m: One deterministic Uniform[-2,-1] draw from the geometry seed before point-cloud generation.
geometry.point_cloud_parameters: Upstream TunnelNetworkPtClGenParams.random(), with every effective tunnel and intersection parameter recorded.
geometry.mesh_parameters: Upstream TunnelNetworkMeshGenParams.from_defaults() with the frozen FTA draw.
geometry.retry_policy: Zero retries, alternate seeds, replacements, repairs, component deletion or best-case selection.

failure_policy: Any identity, mesh, axis, component, replay, resource or complete-visual-review failure seals M0 as FAIL. Do not adapt parameters or replace a parent inside the run.
next_stage_boundary: M0 PASS permits only preparation and user review of an M1 full-100 mesh proposal. M0 meshes are diagnostic and are not reused as formal M1 or training assets.
